title: Tôi nghĩ tôi đã đến nhầm nhà ga
englishTitle: I think I went to the wrong terminal
pronunciation: Toi nghi toi da den nham nha ga
summary: For checking a terminal mistake before you lose time walking, queueing, or dragging luggage farther.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask with the flight number, airline, ticket, or pickup screen visible.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the flight detail first. Staff can point you to a shuttle, walkway, counter, or correct terminal.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi nghĩ tôi đã đến nhầm nhà ga

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi nghĩ means I think; tôi đã đến nhầm means I went to the wrong place; nhà ga means terminal.

breakdown.english: I went to the wrong place

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Immigration, baggage-claim, and SIM-card cards stay useful if you need to reorient inside the terminal.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after a driver drop-off, domestic/international transfer, wrong entrance, or confusing airport sign.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Confirm before security or check-in. Turning around later can cost much more time.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Pickup-area, driver-meet, missing-bag, domestic-terminal, and visa cards cover nearby airport moves.
